subject: general
question: In which type of rainfall, winds move out from a high -pressure area with wind direction clockwise in the northern hemisphere, and anti - clockwise in the southern hemisphere?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Anticyclone**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **An anticyclone** is a** weather phenomenon** characterized by a **broad circulation of winds** revolving around a **central area of high atmospheric pressure.**
 
• In the **Northern Hemisphere**, these winds rotate clockwise, while in the **Southern Hemisphere,** they rotate counterclockwise, as observed from above—an orientation opposite to that of cyclones.
 
• **Surface-based anticyclones** typically result in several effects, including the clearing of skies, the influx of cooler and drier air masses, and the potential formation of fog overnight within regions of heightened atmospheric pressure.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Orography** is the study of the topographic relief of mountains, hills, and elevated terrain within a region. It falls within the broader discipline of geomorphology.
 
• **A cyclone** is a large air mass that rotates around a strong center of low atmospheric pressure. In the Northern Hemisphere, it rotates counterclockwise, while in the Southern Hemisphere, it rotates clockwise, as viewed from above.
 
• **Convection** is a process through which heat travels by the movement of liquids or gases. It occurs when heat is transferred by the movement of these substances.
